title: Psychological and Counselling Support and Legal Advice for Bankrupts
what_it_is: Psychological and Counselling Support and Legal Advice for Bankrupts

sections.label: Support and referrals for bankrupts
sections.summary: Bankrupts' estates are administered by the Official Assignee or Private Trustee, who refer them to social service agencies or legal clinics for support and advice.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: When a person is made a bankrupt, his or her estate will be administered by the Official Assignee or a Private Trustee appointed by the General Division of the High Court.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The Insolvency Office does not provide direct psychological and counselling support or legal advice to bankrupts.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: However, it maintains a list of social service agencies and legal clinics so that it can make the necessary referrals to bankrupts where appropriate.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: If bankrupts require psychological and counselling support, the Official Assignee or appointed Private Trustee will refer them to a suitable social service agency or family service centre.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: If they require legal advice, they are referred to the Legal Aid Bureau or a suitable legal clinic in the community, depending on their profile and the subject matter on which they seek advice.

sections.label: Revised Debt Repayment Scheme
sections.summary: The Revised Debt Repayment Scheme lets pre-bankruptcy individuals with steady income and debts up to $150,000 repay creditors over time and avoid bankruptcy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
sentences.text: In addition, as Mr Gan might be aware, we have over the last few years, instituted the Revised Debt Repayment Scheme which allows individuals, pre-bankruptcy who have a steady stream of income and whose debts do not exceed a certain amount – in this case, we recently revised it to $150,000 – for them to benefit from a programme where these debts can be serviced through a repayment plan over a period of time with their creditors; and in this way, also avoid bankruptcy, the stigma of bankruptcy and also the longer tail impact that bankruptcy may have on the individual.
